title: Released Retainage Settled with the Project Balance
content:
# Released Retainage Settled with the Project Balance

Retainage released on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is settled with the balance in a part that follows how long the project's class allows for that release.

## Rule

Where retainage stands released on the project and its class allows **60 days or more** for that release, the whole of the retainage released is settled with the balance: **100 per cent** of it.

Where retainage stands released on the project and its class allows **fewer than 60 days** for that release, **50 per cent** of the retainage released is settled with the balance and the rest is invoiced on its own.

Where no retainage stands released on the project, none of it is settled with the balance: **0 per cent**.

## The boundary on the release period

The period read is the class's retainage release period in calendar days. A class allowing exactly 60 days allows 60 days or more and takes the first case; a class allowing 45 days takes the second. Where the project's record carries no retainage release at all, the third case governs whatever the class allows.

| Retainage released on the project | The class's release period | Portion settled with the balance |
|---|---|---|
| USD 18000 | 90 days | USD 18000.00 |
| USD 18000 | 60 days | USD 18000.00 |
| USD 18000 | 45 days | USD 9000.00 |
| none | any | nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A project in a class allowing 45 days for the release, carrying USD 12000 of released retainage, settles USD 6000.00 of it with the balance; the other USD 6000.00 is invoiced on its own.
